messages:
incident-bot: [ALERT] Canary rollout 'release-2026-03-17' - p95 latency x3, throughput -40% in eu-west1. Paging #eng-oncall. https://monitoring/alerts/6543219876
sanjay: I'm on it — handing off to oncall (maria). Quick glance shows kernel selector fallback after the deploy.
maria: I'm booting into the canary cluster and pulling logs now. Which rollout ID?
deploy-bot: rollout-id: rollout-20260317-17f5, canary=2%, started 07:12 UTC.
kevin: Graphs show batch processing time spike at the same timestamp as deploy. Pod logs include: "KernelSelector: no optimized kernel for seq_len=2048 -> fallback_generic". Prefetch thrash around same time.
maria: @kevin can you paste the exact log snippet you saw?
kevin: ```WARN KernelSelector: fallback_generic selected for model=llama-65b quant_route=auto seq=2048
  at kernel_selector.go:213 
  reason: missing optimized kernel for (seq,len,quant) combo```
maria: Support impact? errors/5xx?
sue: Support here — two enterprise customers (enterprise-omega, finlytics) reported marked slowdown, no 5xx errors, just long tails and timeouts on client side.
maria: Proposed mitigation: 1) flip feature kill-switch for 'adaptive_kernel_route' to force the previous stable selector 2) if that doesn't improve, rollback canary. Who can flip the flag?
olivia: I can do the flip. Ops flag CLI: `./ops/flags set adaptive_kernel_route=false --env=prod-canary --reason='latency regression'`
olivia: executing now :gear:
oncall-bot: @olivia flag change detected: adaptive_kernel_route=false applied to prod-canary at 07:18 UTC.
maria: Monitoring metrics — p95 dropped from ~1.9s -> ~1.05s within 3 minutes, throughput returning to baseline.
sanjay: Confirming cluster logs now show: "KernelSelector: restored optimized kernel path for llama-65b" and prefetch warnings tapering.
maria: Good. Pause the rollout at 2% and hold for 30m observation. No rollback required yet.
sue: Notified affected customers with a mitigation update. Support ticket IDs: #2456, #2457.
maria: Assigning postmortem owners: kevin (triage logs), olivia (flag playbook), sanjay (monitoring thresholds). @deploy-bot please mark the rollout paused.
deploy-bot: rollout rollout-20260317-17f5 paused at 2% by oncall (maria).
maria: Closing the immediate paging. We'll re-open if regression recurs. Thanks all :white_check_mark:
